description:
intent=i041 snapshot=s05 branch=stacks-outside-net-dirs status=complete
finding location=drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_ib.c:569-600 confidence=medium conclusion=ipoib_send saves phead=skb->data for GSO skbs, skb_linearize can pskb_expand_head-free the old head, and the stale phead is DMA-read by the HCA via tx_wr.header: stale-pointer use of freed head memory.
finding location=drivers/scsi/bnx2fc/bnx2fc_fcoe.c:536-566 confidence=medium conclusion=bnx2fc_recv_frame keeps eth_hdr()-derived mac/dest_mac across pskb_trim(skb, fr_len), which can pskb_expand_head-free the old head for a cloned FCoE frame, so the later dest_mac/mac comparisons read freed memory (stale-pointer UAF read).
finding location=drivers/media/dvb-core/dvb_net.c:248-256 confidence=medium conclusion=handle_one_ule_extension walks p->ule_next_hdr through attacker-chosen optional/mandatory ULE extension headers with no bound against ule_skb->len, so type re-reads at dvb_net.c:255 read past the SNDU into adjacent slab memory (unbounded linear-area read).
unresolved location=drivers/staging/gdm724x/gdm_lte.c:668 conclusion=Follow up: confirm the upper bound (or absence) on the multi-SDU walk at gdm_lte.c:712 and the DHCP chaddr read at gdm_lte.c:577 by tracing phy_dev->rcv_func callers, to determine whether a malicious/compromised LTE modem firmware can read past the receive buffer.
coverage_gap=No runtime confirmation (KASAN build, reproducer, or compile) was possible against this read-only snapshot; all three findings rest on source reading of the exact save/invalidating-call/use lines and on the pskb_expand_head/___pskb_trim/alloc_skb semantics read in this tree.
limitation=All three findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no build, KASAN run or crafted packet was executed, and for the two skb-head findings the head reallocation is inferred from pskb_expand_head's alloc-copy-free of the old head and ___pskb_trim's skb_cloned() branch rather than observed.
limitation=The ipoib finding is a TX-path variant: it needs a GSO skb with nr_frags > usable_sge that is still cloned or non-linear when skb_linearize runs, the stale read is performed by the HCA DMA engine through tx_wr.header, and the observable failure is a malformed header/I/O error rather than a KASAN splat.
limitation=The bnx2fc finding requires the received FCoE frame's skb to be cloned (e.g. by an AF_PACKET tap or GRO) when pskb_trim runs and its length to exceed fr_len; on a never-cloned receive path the stale mac/dest_mac still alias valid memory and the issue is latent, hence medium confidence.
limitation=The dvb_net ULE finding's attacker is the DVB feed content (broadcast stream or malicious mux): the OOB read is from the linear ule_skb allocation rather than past skb_headlen, so it is an adjacent-slab read of at most ~16 bytes per extension-header step unless the unbounded loop accumulates further; triggering requires CONFIG_DVB_NET plus an attached ULE feed.
limitation=Non-linearity and cloning preconditions for the reported sites were assessed structurally (eth_type_trans/GRO/tap cloning behavior), not by a per-driver runtime audit of which s05 configurations actually deliver such skbs.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history or network permitted); line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s05 as supplied, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by assignment rule and never reported.
